title: Samsung watches
symptom: The user asks if there is hope to implement native Samsung watch support in xDrip, noting that current watch support has increased but still no Samsung.
fix: The thread suggests using Juraj Attal's G-Watch Service as a workaround. One user reports that adding an identified receiver in xDrip+ under Inter-app settings with the entry sk.trupici.g_watch makes it work.
settings_changed: Inter-app settings → add identified receiver sk.trupici.g_watch
evidence_quote: I believe I had to add an identified receiver in xdrip+ under Inter-app settings , I have an entry there showing sk.trupici.g_watch which makes it work
